scope: PDF Tools v2 follow-ups end to end: comment dates in local time, the Edit panel's Alignment and Colour, the storage line from files.status, covers kept across closes (pdf.cover), and Combine's footer kept in view. In a hidden OctoSense desktop shell built from this branch (debug, macOS, Apple silicon), rebased on main with #478, so PDF Tools opened at its own window size (the wide layout), with the real pdf engine in the app's own storage; and in App Hub's card-host with the dev fixture at the designs' 1536 x 1024. Every engine call in the shell runs was real.
base: 5c28da7d96aec78278010e73205221318189a0cf (main with #478: a script app opens at its manifest's window size); the sources below are this branch's
head: 80395f7c320986622507857205327e7360649a35

shell.runtime: the root's .sources: makepad d653bc44 with runtime-patches.lock.json's stacked patches, Octoscript-Makepad 6cf2d90a, Octoscript 2e37d9e6
shell.launch: a Terminal.app tab (osascript) under the machine's shell-run lock, one OctoSense at a time: OCTOSENSE_HOME=<fresh home> OCTOS_APP_CORE_DIR=<home>/octos-home/.octos MAKEPAD_HOME=<home>/makepad MAKEPAD_HIDE_WINDOWS=1 MAKEPAD_REMOTE=127.0.0.1:8915 MAKEPAD_WM_TEST_APP=pdftools; ended with /quit
shell.script_budget: the runtime's 64 ms (load averages 15 to 35 while other sessions built)
shell.window: PDF Tools at its own window size (#478): an app area of 1292 x 662 points in the 1400 x 898 hidden shell, the wide layout
shell.time_zone: America/Los_Angeles (PDT, UTC-7): the runs were after 17:00, when UTC is already the next day

card_host.app_hub_revision: 8347a489141c0e24cab564883db7c4592935a8b2 (the one on this machine; it predates the manifest's window hint)
card_host.manifest: the scratch copy's manifest drops `window` and `schema_minor`, which this card-host refuses as unknown keys; main.splash and the rest of the bundle are the branch's own
card_host.script_budget: MAKEPAD_SPLASH_BUDGET_MS=1000: the stand-in engine answers in script

commands: (from phone/) cargo test --locked --features mobile-apps -p octosense-shell --lib files_service
(from phone/) cargo test --locked --features mobile-apps -p octosense-shell --lib pdftools_model
python3 apps/pdftools/tests/ui.py --shell target/debug/octosense --lock <scratch>/octosense-shell.lock --output <scratch>/ui-wide --only shell --only restart --only full --only empty

<venv with PIL> <scratch>/fixture_run.py --card-host <App Hub 8347a489>/target/release/card-host --only fixture --budget-ms 1000 --output <scratch>/ui-fixture (ui.py's card-host run; the wrapper only drops `window` and `schema_minor` from the scratch bundle's manifest)
hub stamp <copy of apps/pdftools/bundle>; hub check <copy> --system-app (the same two findings as main's bundle: no store listing, unsigned; nothing new)
frames: the app's area cut from each shell grab by its sidecar (one pixel per point); card-host side-by-sides halved and reduced to 256 colours (PIL)

runs.shell: the samples, light, then dark through the shell's style menu, the dark pass on what the light pass left
runs.restart: the same home again, with Imported PDF.pdf (pdftools_fixture --import-sample) placed in the library between the runs
runs.full: a fresh home whose storage was filled to 8 KB short of 64 MiB
runs.empty: a fresh home with no PDFs, light then dark
runs.fixture: card-host, a scratch copy of the bundle with dev-fixture/engine.splash in place of engine(), make_fixture.py's documents, 1536 x 1024, light then dark

checks: Storage line: Home said '187 KB of 64 MB used' while the app's storage held 191793 bytes (files.status used_bytes and quota_bytes); its PDFs alone were 38356 bytes, what the old line counted

Comment dates: the highlight made in each pass, and its reply, read 'Today 20:21' (UTC 2026-10-11T03:21Z) and 'Today 20:22' (UTC 2026-10-11T03:22Z): this machine's local time, where the engine stamps UTC (the old reading showed the next day)

Edit (design 08): clause 1 of the lease with Alignment centred and Colour Red (the box opened into its seven colours), applied: the engine drew it centred and red; the dark pass set it flush right in its own colour

Combine: with two PDFs listed, the card's own Combine button stayed in view with no scroll (light: [937, 613, 140, 46] in the app area [54, 76, 1292, 662]; dark: [937, 613, 140, 46] in the app area [54, 76, 1292, 662]); the list scrolls inside the card; before, the button sat 85 points below the fold at this size

Covers: after the shell run, one cover per PDF in .cache/covers (6), each named in library.json; the restart drew none of the 6 current covers again (the same files and times) and drew one for the new import
Full storage: '63.9 of 64 MB used' with the bar full; no room for a cover, each card still shows its pages and size; removing a PDF works
Design size (card-host, 1536 x 1024): Combine's card fits as designed; the Edit panel shows Font, Alignment and Colour as design 08 draws them
No script errors in any run's log (check_log)
not_verified: Linux and Windows (the pdf engine is desktop-only; Windows's offset path, chrono's Local, was not built here); phones
the shell suite beyond files_service and pdftools_model on this branch (see the PR)
